scope: one internal synthetic vertical from publication through operator result

authentication.participant: valid Supabase Auth JWT mapped to iam.user_accounts and core.entrepreneurs
authentication.trusted_worker: server-side app_worker context only; never exposed to the browser

global_rules.write_path: browser -> application command endpoint -> one PostgreSQL transaction; direct browser writes to domain tables are forbidden
global_rules.transaction_rule: domain state, canonical events and outbox rows commit or roll back together
global_rules.event_append: eventing.append_event must be called inside the same transaction as the state change

idempotency.required_for: all POST, PUT and PATCH commands
idempotency.event_id: deterministic UUID derived from the scope
idempotency.request_hash: SHA-256 of canonical request body stored in the causal event payload
idempotency.same_key_same_payload: return the canonical current response with replayed=true and create no new effect
idempotency.serialization: transaction-scoped advisory lock on the idempotency scope

global_rules.resource_hiding: cross-tenant or inaccessible identifiers return 404; authenticated users lacking an allowed action on a visible resource return 403
global_rules.test_data: synthetic internal identities and the internal-only E14 journey; no real participant data

persistence_normalization.welcome: journey instance availability/start state; not a path_steps row
persistence_normalization.diagnosis: diagnostics session before path assignment; not a path_steps row
persistence_normalization.guided_and_standard_paths: two path_templates, each with one path_step referencing the same activity_version; guided behavior is path metadata/presentation mode
persistence_normalization.quick_check: assessment_spec and question attached to the shared activity_version; not a separate path step
persistence_normalization.completion: state transition derived from passed assessment and required content acknowledgements; not a path step

known_gaps.finding: No publish, enrollment, diagnostic, activity, assessment or completion command RPC/handler exists in the live database.
known_gaps.required_action: Implement server-side application command handlers in Step 4; clients must not orchestrate multi-table writes.

known_gaps.finding: Published catalog and diagnostic versions currently have no database trigger preventing mutation.
known_gaps.required_action: Add a migration with state-aware immutability guards before CMD01 can pass AC05.

known_gaps.finding: The private operational repository has no Next.js application in its current tree, but an executable public foundation and a Lovable prototype exist outside it and have not been reconciled with the private domain.
known_gaps.required_action: Audit both frontend references, reuse only compatible UI assets and routes, replace their schema and hardcoded data, and integrate the selected application structure into the private operational repository.

known_gaps.finding: Supabase Auth is available, but a live synthetic JWT to iam/core participant mapping has not yet been proven for this vertical.
known_gaps.required_action: Create synthetic test identities and prove request context in Step 4/7 without real participant data.

known_gaps.finding: The ledger is authoritative, but the timing guarantee for point_balance_projections is not yet defined.
known_gaps.required_action: For the vertical response, compute the authoritative balance from committed ledger entries or update the projection in the same transaction.
